source.name: Arogya Sanjeevani standard product
source.publisher: Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India
source.caveat: Superseded document, product still in force. The Master Circular of 29 May 2024 lists this circular in its Annexure-6 and supersedes it, but carries the standard products forward expressly, so Arogya Sanjeevani remains the mandated standard individual health product and these are still its prescribed terms. One figure has moved since: the moratorium is now 60 months, not eight years, and the Policy row carries the current figure while the clause below quotes what this document says.
source.document: IRDAI/HLT/REG/CIR/193/07/2020, 22 July 2020, Master Circular on Standardization of Health Insurance Products.

policy.notes: Terms prescribed by IRDAI, not set by the insurer. Every figure here is quoted from the Master Circular of 22 July 2020 except two. The pre-existing waiting period is inherited from standard exclusion Excl01, which that section does not restate. The moratorium is 60 months, set by the Master Circular of 29 May 2024, which supersedes the 2020 circular; the standard products are expressly carried forward, so the product stands while the document it was quoted from does not.

clauses.cite: Arogya Sanjeevani, Customer Information Sheet, Loss sharing 6(a)(i)(a)
clauses.text: Room Rent - Up to 2% of SI, subject to max of INR 5,000 per day.

clauses.cite: Arogya Sanjeevani, Customer Information Sheet, Loss sharing 6(a)(i)(b)
clauses.text: ICU charges - Up to 5% of SI subject to max of INR 10,000 per day.

clauses.cite: Arogya Sanjeevani, Customer Information Sheet, Loss sharing 6(a)(i)(c)
clauses.text: In case Room/ICU/ICCU rent exceeds the limits specified the claim shall be subject to the proportionate deduction.

clauses.cite: Arogya Sanjeevani, Customer Information Sheet, Loss sharing 6(b)
clauses.text: Each and every claim under the Policy shall be subject to a Copayment of 5% applicable to claim amount admissible and payable as per the terms and conditions of the Policy.

clauses.cite: Master Circular, Arogya Sanjeevani, Para C.13
clauses.text: Limits on cataract Surgery: expenses incurred on treatment of Cataract shall be covered up to 25% of Sum insured or Rs.40,000/- whichever is lower, per eye.
The minimum sum insured under the standard product shall be Rs 1,00,000/-. Maximum limit shall be Rs 5 lakhs, in multiples of fifty thousand.

clauses.cite: Master Circular, Arogya Sanjeevani, Paras 11 and 12
clauses.text: Pre-hospitalisation medical expenses incurred for 30 days prior to the date of hospitalisation are admissible, and post-hospitalisation medical expenses for 60 days from the date of discharge following an admissible claim are included.
Expenses incurred on hospitalisation under AYUSH systems of medicine shall be covered without any sub-limits.

clauses.cite: Master Circular, Standard wordings, Moratorium Period
clauses.text: After completion of eight continuous years under the policy no look back to be applied. This period of eight years is called as moratorium period.
